status: conditional real probe/gauge/HC sector, exact current identities; no native full closure or adopted action change

assumptions.carrier: generation tensor spin, internal fields commute with spin matrices
assumptions.adjoint: bar(Psi)=Psi^dagger eta_D, eta_D Hermitian, K^mu=eta_D Gamma^mu Hermitian and constant
assumptions.mass_term: eta_D Omega Hermitian; tested central mass plus gamma H_C

real_probe_action.L: i(Psi^dagger K^mu partial_mu Psi-partial_mu Psi^dagger K^mu Psi)/2-Tr(A_mu j^mu)-m Tr(S)-gamma Tr(H S)
real_probe_action.commuting_real_HC_transport: Re[i kappa bar(Psi) Gamma.n H Psi]=0; the same holds for Hermitian closure load
real_probe_action.general_noncommuting_rule: Herm(i K.n H)=i[K.n,H]/2, not the original ordered transport

paired_bosonic_sector_plus_sources.curvature_choice: alternative -Tr(F^dagger F)/4 from HC_Null_Axis_Action_Check, not a native correction
paired_bosonic_sector_plus_sources.gauge_equation: D_mu^A F_A^{mu nu}+i kappa^2 n_mu[H,X^{mu nu}]-j^nu=0
paired_bosonic_sector_plus_sources.hc_equation: kappa^2 n_nu D_mu^A X^{mu nu}-2lambda_H(H-Lambda)-gamma S=0
paired_bosonic_sector_plus_sources.target_reaction: E_Lambda=2lambda_H(H-Lambda) for an external covariant matching target

ward_identity.matter_on_shell: D_mu j^mu=-i gamma[H,S]; its ordinary trace is conserved
ward_identity.fixed_target_consistency: If A,H,Psi solve these equations and Lambda is not varied, lambda_H>0 requires [H,Lambda]=0 unless extra background reactions are retained

norm_balance_example.orientation: chosen null covector with K.n=I+sigma_x positive; reversing n reverses the raw HC norm source

open_model_comparison.assumption: positive damping D in an already positive modal metric; not automatic for native gamma-ordered HC

moving_comparison_route.time_chart_condition: Q_dot+G^dagger Q+Q G=0 makes f^dagger Q f conserved for f_dot=G f
moving_comparison_route.formal_solution: Q(t)=U(t)^(-dagger) Q0 U(t)^(-1); this is not a native metric derivation
moving_comparison_route.pure_HC_branch_obstruction: Nonzero ordinary Hermitian F_mu_nu cannot be skew for any strictly positive Q. The pure commuting HC wedge must vanish for this strong bundle route.
moving_comparison_route.flat_HC_example: constant H, B_mu=kappa n_mu H, Q(x)=exp(2kappa H n.x) has F=0 and compatible positive Q

native_comparison_anchors_checked.QAM: 07_qam_infrastructure.tex, def:two-sided-admissible-contractions and ex:two-sided-residual-comparison: typed residual comparison, not an evaluated Dirac kinetic metric

native_comparison_anchors_checked.quaternionic_inner_product: 10_sphaera_and_physics.tex, prop:orthogonality-third-kernel: basis inner product, not an evaluated probe-adjoint/carrier map

remaining_choices: use a closed real probe action with HC bosonic kinetics and gamma coupling, explicitly changing the raw transport law
or retain raw norm-changing transport as an open/conditional law and derive its missing environment, metric and currents
an independent adjoint needs a specified real/doubled field space; a moving comparison needs its background law, adjoint and derivative terms
do not interpret a Hermitian-to-anti-Hermitian HC shift as harmless: with free A its vector shift can be absorbed into the total connection
